title: Pit-Firing through Ceramics Residency
cost_text: $700-1000/month for housing plus materials and firing fees
source_quote: Their work is rooted in being in dialogue with material - both clay in its most malleable form and with the fire that paints it. He primarily uses pit-firing and wood-firing
how_to_join: Apply through Mendocino Art Center residency application
